what: R6 warp-net training rule (fills in r6_train_plan's warp clause), sealed before any R6 training: no R6 model or result exists.
setting: head-model commit 6ac8357: scripts/r5_warp.py pointed at R6 by environment (HM_R5_RUNS runs/r6, HM_R5_MANIFEST data/manifests/r6.json, HM_R5_DATASET Dataset603_MRHeadR6, HM_R5_TRAINER_DIR nnUNetTrainerHMThick430__nnUNetPlans__3d_fullres) and scripts/train_r6_warp.sh. Labels: every head of Dataset603's 5-fold split predicted by the one fold that held it out, through navprep's own segment stage, on the case's charm input T1; warp input = that conformed T1 and those labels, our raw affine from them (template runs/wp3b/template_trainminusval); target = charm's own MNI map. Model: warpnet NetConfig defaults; TrainConfig defaults except w_tail 1.0, w_gate 4.0, val_every 20, max_hours 30 per run: all as r5_warp_train, unchanged.
sets: train = Dataset603's training heads minus the validation heads; validation = the 30 WP3b validation cases + the 30 IXI validation heads (r5_set 'val' in the R5 manifest) + the 40 OASIS-3 validation heads (manifest_r6: per stratum the 20 training participants with the smallest sha1('r6-oasis3-val:' + participant), chosen from the sealed train list before any charm result was looked at; 'r5_set': 'val' in data/manifests/r6.json). Test heads (R5's, OASIS-3's) are never read.
epochs: Epoch pilot as r5_warp_train: runs of 100 and 200 epochs, each a full cosine schedule, scored by r5_warp.py score on the first 5 sorted validation heads (score_gate = mean of targets mean, rTMS EEG set mean, fiducial mean; unprojected). gain = score_100 - score_200; final length 200 if gain < 0.03 mm, 350 if < 0.10, else 500. The model is the final run's last.pt (not the best on validation), its support stored in it, linked as runs/r6/warp/final.
rule: Nothing here changes after any R6 warp result is seen, except by a new sealed amendment that says why. This rule only trains; r6_e2e alone decides adoption.
no_folding: not judged here (training only); r6_e2e requires written-map min Jacobian > 0 in both maps on every test case of R6's 1 mm arm.
disclosure: Known before sealing: R5's warp pilot scores (100 epochs 2.566, 200 epochs 2.241 mm, gain 0.325 -> 500 epochs) and R5's results (docs/r5_e2e_report.md). No OASIS-3 head has been scored by any warp net or segmenter. The code is smoke-tested on 6 OASIS-3 training heads with a 1-epoch segmenter and a 2-epoch warp (scratch directory, numbers meaningless) before sealing.
